title: Ron Jackson | Cloud Resume Challenge
text:
Cloud Resume Challenge
Building a cloud-native personal website — the full story and technical breakdown.
☁️ The Cloud Resume Challenge
An initiative by Forrest Brazeal to help cloud practitioners demonstrate real-world skills
by building and deploying a resume as a live cloud application — not just another PDF.
What Is It?
Overview
The
Cloud Resume Challenge
is a multi-step hands-on project that takes you
through building a complete cloud-hosted website using real AWS (or Azure/GCP) services.
It's designed to bridge the gap between passing a certification exam and actually doing
cloud work — demonstrating that you can build, deploy, secure, and monitor a live application.
This site
is
my Cloud Resume Challenge.
Every page, every feature, is part of
the deployment and architecture I built from scratch.

Written Statement
A personal overview — who I am, what I bring, and where I'm going.
About Me
Introduction
My career in technology has taken a varied path.
After spending 15 years working in the video games industry, I moved into IT in 2010, beginning a new chapter that has developed into a career spanning technical support, infrastructure, systems administration and enterprise technology.
Today, I work as a Senior IT Engineer at Redpanda, where I combine my experience in IT with a strong interest in emerging technologies.
I also serve as an AI Champion, helping to explore how artificial intelligence can be understood and applied practically within the workplace.
Continuous learning has always been an important part of my career.
Alongside my professional experience, I have continued my academic development through the Open University, while more recently expanding my knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and developing a deeper understanding of AI through certification, experimentation and hands-on projects.
What continues to motivate me is the opportunity to learn, solve problems and understand how new technologies can be put to practical use.
From video games to IT, cloud and AI, that curiosity has been a constant throughout my career.
